subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve restart intent across coalesced config writes

question: Should the gateway owner accept the pending-origin restart-intent policy after the exact current-main merge result has rerun the focused reload tests?
rationale: The patch is narrow and well-proven, but it changes lifecycle semantics across asynchronous writer and watcher paths; choosing that reliability boundary is not a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Approve after merge-head proof
options.body: Recommended: retain the bounded pending-origin policy and require the focused gateway reload matrix on the exact merge commit.

options.title: Request a narrower lifecycle audit
options.body: Pause for owner review if the current main reloader has changed enough that pending-versus-active provenance needs a fresh state-transition comparison.
